data.one_liner: Integrate Toss Payments widgets and payment flows into Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides widget integration for the Toss Payments SDK on Flutter, allowing developers to render payment methods, handle agreements, request payments, and manage payment redirects.
use_when: You need to integrate Toss Payments into an Android or iOS Flutter app.
You want to use Toss Payments checkout widgets and agreement components.
avoid_when: You are using a payment gateway other than Toss Payments.
Your target platforms do not include Android or iOS.
strengths: Official widget SDK support for Toss Payments in Flutter.
Handles payment methods, agreements, and app-to-app redirects (such as Alipay/Antom).
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration (such as Android INTERNET permission and cleartext traffic settings).
Limited to a single payment gateway ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting Android INTERNET permission and enabling usesCleartextTraffic in AndroidManifest.xml.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are integrating Stripe instead of Toss Payments for your gateway.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need native app store in-app purchases rather than a third-party payment gateway.
